answer: Here an account is a promise of future work. The ledger tests that promise each epoch with a new sable and a jury of peers. Attestation weight is discounted when the accounts vouching for you are the ones you vouch for, and kinship in the invite graph triggers the same discount. A closed mesa of sock puppets scores near the floor no matter how many keys it adds, because escaping the discount requires genuine third-party verification. So a delta of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1e7eq.
